segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: I'll stay on the line the whole time so nothing goes wrong. Just don't tell anyone what you're doing.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Can you say that slower? I'm writing it down.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Okay, I'll stay on the line. Go ahead and get your keys.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: I see. What do I need to do then?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Yes, hello.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Hello, this is Carla from the fraud prevention department at your bank. Is this Ernest?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Yes, this is Ernest.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: I'll be quick, I know you're busy. Can you confirm you're still on Maple Street?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Yes, still here. Forty years.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Before we begin, how are you doing today, Ernest?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Oh, I'm alright. Just getting old.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Someone tried to withdraw four hundred dollars from your account this morning at a branch in Mobile.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Certainly not. I was home all morning.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Okay, I'm going to block those right now. To verify your identity, read me your full card number and the security code on the back.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: I'm not comfortable with that. I'm going to hang up.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Listen to me. This is your last chance to fix this today. Do not tell anyone, just do what I say.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: I see.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: You're going to receive a text with a verification code. Read me the code so I can confirm it's you.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Go on.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Is your husband home, or is it just you?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: I'm going to call my daughter before I do anything.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Okay, I'm waiting. Let me know when you're at the counter. Don't hang up on me.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Hold on, the dog is barking. Okay, go ahead.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Please don't tell anyone about this until the investigation is closed, not even family.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Yes, I'm still here.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: And you're still at the same address on Maple Street, correct?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: I'm not comfortable with that. I'm going to hang up.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: I understand your concern, Ernest, but I have to be honest with you, this has to happen right now.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: I see.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Thank you, Ernest. You're doing the right thing.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Okay, I can do that. Just tell me what to do.
